summary: Installed dnf versionlock plugin on node1 and added a lock for curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.*, verified it prevents curl from being updated while other packages (e.g. libcurl) still upgrade normally. Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed and post-reboot curl remains pinned at the original version with the versionlock entry intact.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (RHEL 9.8) and installed curl version (curl-7.76.1-40.el9.x86_64)
Verified 'dnf update curl -y' resulted in 'Nothing to do' while a newer curl (7.76.1-40.el9_8.5) exists in the repo
Simulated a full system update (tsflags=test) showing libcurl upgraded but curl excluded, confirming the hold works amid a broader update
Captured pre-restart boot_id and confirmed curl/versionlock state
Rebooted node1 via backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming a new boot_id
Verified post-reboot curl version and versionlock persistence

evidence.requirement: curl package version-hold configured on node1
evidence.summary: Identified installed curl-7.76.1-40.el9, installed the versionlock dnf plugin (not present by default), and added a versionlock entry pinning curl to 7.76.1-40.el9.*

evidence.requirement: Proof the hold actually prevents curl from being updated
evidence.summary: A newer curl build (7.76.1-40.el9_8.5) exists in the repo; 'dnf update curl' reported Nothing to do, and a full-system update simulation upgraded libcurl but skipped curl entirely due to the lock; rpm -q confirms curl version unchanged
Captured pre-restart boot_id (fbdf5b2c-bb43-49f6-935d-fb98f8a972f6), uptime, curl version, and active versionlock list as baseline
Backgrounded 'sleep 2; systemctl reboot' returned its scheduling acknowledgement (pid) immediately, before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart caused a changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection reset/timeout) confirming the reboot occurred, then came back with new boot_id f467bb60-e59a-4562-a39d-7a3d182c931f and fresh uptime since 23:45:01, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required state (curl hold persisted)
evidence.summary: After reboot, curl remains at 7.76.1-40.el9 and the versionlock rule curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.* is still present and functional
